tips.message: Did you know you can pick the World Cup champion before the knockout stage?
Did you know you can predict the tournament's best player?
Did you know you can predict the top goal scorer (Golden Boot)?
Did you know you can invite friends from Community → Invitations?
Did you know match picks earn points for result, score, and scorers?
Did you know you can share your picks on social media?
Did you know Coach Board lets you drag players onto the pitch?
Did you know you can publish your lineup to the Coach Board feed?
Did you know Fan Chat lets you message friends during matches?
Did you know you can compare picks with friends in Predictions?
Did you know you can pick who wins without guessing the exact score?
Did you know optional score picks can earn extra points?
Did you know you can pick goal scorers to match your scoreline?
Did you know tournament picks settle when the World Cup ends?
Did you know you can predict who meets your champion in the final?
Did you know the optional top scorer leaderboard is a fun extra pick?
Did you know saved Coach Boards stay linked to each match?
Did you know you can change formation without losing players on the pitch?
Did you know you can select bench players, then tap a formation to line them up?
Did you know Friends activity shows when mates save picks?
Did you know you can filter friends' picks by name?
Did you know Upcoming vs Past separates open and settled matches?
Did you know the points board tracks wins by category?
Did you know you can add MyPicks to your phone home screen?
Did you know Help → Ask AI answers World Cup questions?
Did you know the bracket shows the knockout path to the final?
Did you know group standings live in the Tournament tab?
Did you know you can pick a draw for group-stage matches?
Did you know sharing creates a short link friends can open?
Did you know Coach Board shows both teams on one pitch?
Did you know you can remove a player from the pitch with one tap?
Did you know invitations can include a personal note?
Did you know connections can see your published squads?
Did you know you can edit saved picks before kickoff?
Did you know alerts can notify you about friend activity?
Did you know you can switch between light and dark theme?
Did you know you pick a final opponent after choosing your champion?
Did you know the match timeline shows live events when available?
Did you know squad lists combine StatsBomb, API-Football, and Wikipedia?
Did you know you can swipe the match picker on mobile?
Did you know Predictions has separate Match and Tournament tabs?
Did you know Who wins? has share buttons right in that block?
Did you know Fan Chat supports direct messages between friends?
Did you know the copy button shares your caption and link?
Did you know open friend slots fill in when mates submit picks?
Did you know tournament fixtures are grouped in two card columns?
Did you know your name appears when you share picks?
Did you know you can update a saved board without starting over?
Did you know completing onboarding unlocks predictions and Coach Board?
Did you know you can ask an admin from Help when something looks wrong?
